Protection is delegated to supported native providers on the Paseo daemon host. Paseo permission notifications are not blocking hooks. Terminals, daemon git/browser actions, plugin code, custom commands, ACP providers, relocated native homes, and remote hosts are not covered. Native runtime failure behavior and approval/resume support remain provider-specific.
